code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v != 0)
    color = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == color]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = {(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points}
    original = [row[:] for row in g]
    max_r = max(r for r, c in shape)
    max_c = max(c for r, c in shape)
    for dr in range(h-max_r):
        for dc in range(w-max_c):
            if all(original[dr+r][dc+c] == 0 for r, c in shape):
                for r, c in shape:
                    g[dr+r][dc+c] = color
    return g
'''
